name: vt-ping-pong

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: Liveness on the C4 socket (D17; C4 decision 10): ping is answered by pong, from the VT worker's own loop — a hung CGo call is a dead VT worker. ping carries only its cmd and pong only its event, so there is no id to correlate and the pairing is by order; two pings in flight are answered in that order. After hello and hello_ack, the core probes twice and the VT answers each with a pong. Graded by the U4 worker (owed) and the U2 core (owed).
